text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After heading out with Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, did you have 
somewhere to be after this, Trainer?"
choice_data_list:
A coworker invited me to a water gun 
survival game...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Sounds fun! Hey, do you mind 
if I come along too?
choice_data_list:
There are other students here too, so I 
think it should be fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"All right, let's go! Hehe, I'm itching 
for some action."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hello... Oh? Mr. C.B., you're 
participating too?
choice_data_list: You were a member too, Tazuna-san!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you surprised? I may not look it, but 
I'm actually quite experienced, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Looks that way. My ears and tail are 
tingling. ...I kind of want to fight 
her—Tazuna-san, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can match an active 
Umamusume like you, but... let's make it a 
good match.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the curtain rose on the battle, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You too, and you as well... Your backs 
are completely wide open♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san launched a furious assault 
right from the get-go, steadily 
dismantling my side of the board.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, an attack from behind this time, 
huh~? Well, if it's just that much— I can 
do it too!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That shot from behind the tree... 
must have been from C.B.-san. To counter 
by mirroring my movements—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but my aim is still lacking. I need 
to calm down more and line up my sights 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No way, they're shooting from there!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha... What do I do? This is way more 
fun than I thought...!!

text_block_list.name: Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san seems to have the upper hand 
right now, but those two are pretty much 
evenly matched.
choice_data_list: A beginner can only watch over them.
A beginner can only watch over them.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My, don't say such dreary things. Why 
don't the two of you join in the fun as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Colleague
text_block_list.text: Crap... Whoaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My colleague is shot, and the water gun's 
muzzle turns toward me. Just as I could do 
nothing but watch the scene unfold in slow 
motion—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... Are you all right? You fell 
backwards pretty hard, so you must've 
banged your back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Shh...! Don't move. It might be cramped, 
but let's hold our breath and wait it out 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like they're gone. That was 
close! So scary!
choice_data_list:
You look like you're having a ton of fun 
despite that, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's fun. The stronger the opponent, 
the more thrilling it gets!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whether Ms. Tazuna manages to outrun me, 
or I manage to catch up to her... There's 
no way this wouldn't fire me up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s eyes sparkled with the same 
brilliance as when she's racing. Seeing 
her like that filled me with a passionate 
heat.
choice_data_list: Let's make a late charge just like always!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s eyes sparkled with the same 
brilliance as when she's racing. Seeing 
her like that filled me with a passionate 
heat.
choice_data_list: Let's make a late charge just like always!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, right?! Then let's start our 
counterattack—the two of us together."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, step in closer! Let's have a real 
shootout!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You are quite aggressive. However, aren't 
you sticking your neck out a bit too 
much...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—No, you are the only one left who can 
defeat me. Is that why you seek a head-on 
clash? Then, I shall gladly accept your 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I love that spirit...! But there's one 
thing you've got wrong!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: The one who will defeat you is—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. To think C.B.-san would 
act as a decoy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This time is special. My Trainer, who said 
they wanted to win, smelled like a winner. 
That's why.
choice_data_list: Thanks for trusting me with this.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, a victory born from the bond 
between the two of you. However, I won't 
lose next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three exchanged passionate handshakes, 
bringing the water gun survival game to a 
close.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My body is all warmed up, so now's 
when the real work begins...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Up in a tree...! Well, that's just like 
CB-san to pull a stunt like that!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's not all, hup! Look look, can you 
dodge this!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not on my watch...! I've already prepared 
a countermeasure for dual guns...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Then what if it's not two guns?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...!! I've... been beaten, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... To think you'd control the 3rd 
Block with your foot. You caught up and 
overtook me brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's that about?! Tazuna-san, you 
were really strong too. Strong enough that 
I want to challenge you again and again!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, will you give me a chance at revenge? 
In that case, I'll have to sharpen my 
skills♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the sunset at their backs, the 
champions exchanged a handshake— And just 
like that, another chapter was added to 
the legend of Mr. C.B.
